title: Linear Search
instructions:
Complete the `linearSearch` function. It takes a `List<Int>` called `numbers` and an `Int` called `target`. It should return the index where `target` is found, or `-1` if `target` is not in the list.

Use a `for` loop to check each element one by one.
hint: Loop through the indices with `for (i in numbers.indices)`. Inside the loop, check if `numbers[i] == target`. If so, return `i`. After the loop, return `-1`.
